## What changed

Describe the change and its scope.

## Why

Explain the defect, compatibility issue, or maintenance requirement.

## Validation

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `make test-race`
- [ ] `make e2e`
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior has regression coverage
- [ ] Documentation and contracts are updated

## Risk

Describe security, compatibility, performance, determinism, and proof-integrity impact.

## Open-source compliance

- [ ] No secrets, private captures, customer data, generated binaries, or vendored code were committed
- [ ] New third-party material has a compatible license and documented provenance
- [ ] Public API and file-format changes follow the compatibility policy
